answer: Since the throttle counters live in the harbor ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 126 keys as a result forfeits for 126 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the juniper quota and the saffron admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 2 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. That is 20 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
